integrity: The proof uses a conditional Gaussian identity and an explicitly proven product-small-ball lemma; experiments only cross-check special examples.
scientific_limitations: The theorem treats fixed deterministic real matrices and one shared Gaussian left factor; it is not a guarantee for the independent-column sketches in the cited papers. Asymptotic constants hold with fixed singular values. Self-review only; no independent audit.
title: A sharp rank–probe crossover for shared-factor Gaussian tensor sketches
